commands: NEWHOST=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /moodle/redis/endpoint --region $REGION --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -z "$NEWHOST" ]; then echo 'No Redis endpoint found in SSM; aborting'; exit 1; fi
getent hosts "$NEWHOST" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Could not resolve new Redis IP'; exit 1; }
getent hosts "$NEWHOST" | head -n1 | sed 's/ .*$//' | awk '{print $0 " shared-redis-ha.kbi0dr.ng.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com"}' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
nc -z -w2 shared-redis-ha.kbi0dr.ng.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com 6379 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Old hostname now reachable' || echo 'Still unreachable'
